headword: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}

definitions.gloss: field trip; off-campus learning; outdoor study
definitions.explanation: Educational activities conducted outside the school, such as visits to museums, factories, nature parks, or historical sites. A regular part of the Japanese school curriculum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a field trip next week.

examples.japanese: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We visited a museum on our field trip.

examples.japanese: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: On field trip days, students are supposed to bring their own lunches.

notes: Compound of ⟦{校外|こうがい}→校外：24139_kougai⟧ (off-campus) + ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (learning/study). Japanese schools regularly conduct {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう} as part of the curriculum. Related terms: ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧ (excursion, usually shorter and more recreational), ⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧ (school trip, usually multi-day), {社会科見学|しゃかいかけんがく} (social studies field trip). Common collocation: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go on a field trip).
